Message.Name: Start of Spin Message
Message.Description: This message appears on all channels and indicates the beginning of a spin message cycle.

Field.Name: ChannelSeqNum
Field.Description: Monotonically increasing message sequence number at the channel level.

Field.Name: SpinType
Field.Description: Spin type

Field.Name: SpinStartTimeMilli
Field.Description: Milliseconds since UTC epoch.

Field.Name: SpinLastSeqNum
Field.Description: Last sequence number applied to this spin.

Message.Name: End of Spin Message
Message.Description: This message appears on all channels and indicates the end of a spin message cycle.

Field.Name: ChannelSeqNum
Field.Description: Monotonically increasing message sequence number at the channel level.

Field.Name: SpinType
Field.Description: Spin type

Field.Name: SpinMsgCt
Field.Description: Total number of messages in the spin.

Field.Name: SpinEndTimeMilli
Field.Description: Milliseconds since UTC epoch.

Field.Name: SpinLastSeqNum
Field.Description: Last sequence number applied to this spin.

Message.Name: Market Open Message
Message.Description: This message is sent out at 6 AM on all channels. The message can also be sent mid-day if a technical outage caused a temporary closure of the market.

Field.Name: ChannelSeqNum
Field.Description: Monotonically increasing message sequence number at the channel level.

Field.Name: MarketOpen
Field.Description: Market open time in milliseconds since UTC epoch.

Field.Name: MarketClose
Field.Description: Anticipated market close time in milliseconds since UTC epoch.

Message.Name: Market Close Message
Message.Description: This message is sent out at 5 PM on all channels. The message can also be sent mid-day if a technical outage causes a temporary closure of the market.

Field.Name: ChannelSeqNum
Field.Description: Monotonically increasing message sequence number at the channel level.

Field.Name: MarketCloseTimeMilli
Field.Description: Market close time in milliseconds since UTC epoch midnight.

Field.Name: MarketMsgCt
Field.Description: Total day message count.

Message.Name: Extended Trade Message
Message.Description: Extended Trade Channel message. Created for every trade that occurs on OTC Markets OTC Link ATS, OTC Link ECN, and OTC Link NQB platforms. Differs from Trade in that TradeID is 8 bytes, and TradeSize and TradePrice are 8 bytes with 8 decimal places assumed for fractional shares.

Field.Name: ChannelSeqNum
Field.Description: Monotonically increasing message sequence number at the channel level.

Field.Name: TradeID
Field.Description: Unique Trade ID.

Field.Name: TradeAction
Field.Description: Trade action indicator.

Field.Name: TradeFlags
Field.Description: Trade flags. See TradeFlag definition.

Field.Name: SecurityID
Field.Description: OTC Markets security ID.

Field.Name: TradeStatus
Field.Description: Trade status flags. See TradeStatus definition.

Field.Name: Venue
Field.Description: Executing venue. Values: ATS, ECN, NQB.

Field.Name: Deprecated
Field.Description: Deprecated field. Spaces will be sent in message.

Field.Name: TradePrice
Field.Description: Trade price. Eight decimal places assumed.

Field.Name: TradeSize
Field.Description: Number of shares. Eight decimal places assumed for fractional shares.

Field.Name: TradeTimeMilli
Field.Description: Milliseconds from UTC epoch.

Bitfield.Name: Trade Flag
Bitfield.Description: Trade Flag bitfield included in Trade and Extended Trade messages.

Field.Name: Deprecated
Field.Description: Deprecated.

Field.Name: Reserved
Field.Description: Reserved Trade Flag bits.

Field.Name: Irregular
Field.Description: Indicates irregular trade

Field.Name: Reserved
Field.Description: Reserved Trade Status Bits
